bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot*) ;; *) exit 61;; esac
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
stage="$root/.worktrees/video-stars-361267cb"
sha="361267cb5e636d4fcc70655c63dada5672a98916"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 62
test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 63
newtag="create-videobot:stars-sticker-shared-361267c"
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$newtag")"
mapfile -t ids < <(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)
test "${#ids[@]}" -eq 1 || exit 64
old="${ids[0]}"
oldtag="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$old")"
test "$oldtag" = "create-videobot:video-ui-be4f34d" || { echo VIDEO_LIVE_VERSION_CHANGED; exit 65; }
oldid="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$old")"
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$old")"
files="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}' "$old")"
base="${files%%,*}"
case "$base" in *compose.videobot.poll.yaml) ;; *) exit 66;; esac
test -f "$base" || exit 67
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" config --quiet || exit 68
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$oldtag")" = "$oldid" || exit 69
override="$(mktemp -d "$root/.worktrees/video-stars-deploy.XXXXXXXX")"
cat > "$override/live.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  videobot-poll:
    image: create-videobot:stars-sticker-shared-361267c
YAML
cat > "$override/rollback.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  videobot-poll:
    image: create-videobot:video-ui-be4f34d
YAML
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" -f "$override/live.yaml" config --quiet || { rm -rf "$override"; exit 70; }
changed=0
rollback() {
 rc=$?
 trap - ERR
 set +e
 if test "$changed" = 1; then
  docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" -f "$override/rollback.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps videobot-poll >/dev/null
  echo VIDEO_STARS_ROLLBACK_ATTEMPTED
 fi
 rm -rf "$override"
 exit "$rc"
}
trap rollback ERR
changed=1
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" -f "$override/live.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps videobot-poll
sleep 8
mapfile -t actual < <(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$project" --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)
test "${#actual[@]}" -eq 1 || { echo VIDEO_STARS_POLLER_COUNT_MISMATCH; false; }
running="${actual[0]}"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$running")" = "$newid" || { echo VIDEO_STARS_IMAGE_MISMATCH; false; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$running")" = true || { echo VIDEO_STARS_POLLER_DOWN; false; }
trap - ERR
rm -rf "$override"
echo VIDEO_STARS_RUNTIME_DEPLOY_PASS
echo VIDEO_STARS_POLLER_COUNT=1
echo VIDEO_STARS_SOURCE_SHA="$sha"
